DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteoarthritis of the left knee.

The combination of insidious onset over two months, morning stiffness lasting less than 30 minutes, and the imaging findings of joint space narrowing and osteophytes without the inflammatory markers or erosions seen in rheumatologic conditions point to degenerative joint disease. The lack of systemic symptoms like fever and weight loss further rules out septic arthritis or malignancy.
